lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏴ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏣᏪᏎᎭ; ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏁᏨᏁᎸᎢ; ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎯᎦᏘᏏ ᏣᎪᏇᎷᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
lines.text: A-se-no a-yv hi-a ni-tsa-we-se-ha; Tle-s-di yi-tsa-tle-ge-s-di u-so-nv ne-tsv-ne-lv-i; gi-lo-s-gi-ni hi-ga-ti-si tsa-go-que-lu-hv-s-ge-s-di, so-i na-s-quo hi-ya-li-s-go-lv-da-ne-he-s-di.
lines.english: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏣᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᎾᎡᏗᏱ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏣᏄᏬ, ᎤᏛᏃᎯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
lines.text: Gi-lo-no u-du-li-s-ge-s-di tsa-yi-li-da-s-di-yi, a-le tsa-na-e-di-yi ha-wi-ni tsa-nu-wo, u-dv-no-hi na-s-quo hi-nv-ne-he-s-di.
lines.english: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
